charge_port.notes: Genesis USA: starting with 2026 models every Genesis EV has a NACS port.
Estimated: Genesis Canada announced exclusively NACS on all new or refreshed Genesis EVs from 2025; the 2026 GV70 is the refreshed car.

supercharger_access.notes: Genesis USA: the NACS port gives access to more than 36,000 Tesla Superchargers.
Estimated: Native NACS port on the refreshed 2026 car; Green Car Reports: native Supercharger support, no adapter needed (US report); Genesis Canada announcement.
